rights_rule: No community-controlled or oral sacred narrative is admissible without explicit permission/provenance clearance; absence is preferred to unauthorized extraction.
anti_cherry_pick_rule: A slot cannot be replaced after any scoring output is observed. Rejected candidates and rejection reasons remain append-only receipts.
leakage_rule: Control class and source identity are removed from scorer-facing packets after coding; only opaque packet IDs and frozen feature values remain.
synthetic_output_rule: C09 and C10 actual shuffled matrices are forbidden until the double-coded and arbitrated scorer matrix is frozen; only generator, constraints and seed commitments are frozen at this phase.
